startHere.note: Old traumas that still know how to pull me out of a moment. Decades of being taught to read other people's breathing instead of my own. The wiring doesn't undo itself just because I walked out.
Four files, one a week. The things that happened in my family that nobody would believe, so I wrote them down as evidence.
The church I grew up in had stage lights, a full band, and a sermon that felt like a show. Every Sunday was an episode. This is what the lights were covering.
Grief doesn't leave. Turns out sunshine doesn't either. Start here if you need proof there's still yellow on the other side.
